data.title: 榊由美子 · 暴风雨灯塔内的透湿温存
data.description: 狂风暴雨呼啸肆虐的海岸悬崖，废弃灯塔圆柱形石室内，窗外电闪雷鸣，滔天巨浪撞击在斑驳礁石上。被雨水彻底浇透的衣物早已褪尽散落一旁，浑身湿漉漉的由美子瘫软在干燥的毛毯上。水珠顺着她湿透紧贴脸颊与白皙脖颈的乌黑发丝缓缓滑落，穿过起伏剧烈的锁骨与娇嫩粉红的峰峦，在光滑的小腹上汇聚成水线。在苍白闪电瞬间照亮室内的刹那，由美子眼眶微红地紧紧抱住雄二的肩膀，将一直以来筑起的心灵坚壁彻底粉碎，在风暴中将最纯洁的灵魂与娇躯全盘托付。
data.location: 雷雨轰鸣、电闪雷鸣的悬崖老旧灯塔石室内部
data.action: 湿漉的身躯蜷在毛毯上，湿发紧贴锁骨，双手环抱拥向对方，眼眶含泪献上纯情
data.lighting: 窗外刺目惨白的闪电瞬间高光与室内残烛幽暗暖色交错
data.promptProse: Viewed from slightly above inside a stone coastal lighthouse lashed by rain outside the window, Yumiko presses close against her partner on a floor blanket, arms wrapped tightly around his shoulders. Candlelight and a pale flash of storm light catch the rainwater on her face and tear-bright gaze.
data.nsfwProse: Completely unclothed after stripping off her rain-soaked clothes, droplets trail across her flushed collarbones and bare breasts pressed against her partner.
data.animaCaption: Lying completely nude and rain-dampened on the dry blanket inside the storm-swept lighthouse, she clings tightly around her partner's shoulders with wet hair sticking to her collarbone and tearful eyes catching the lightning and candlelight.
